svg.title: Linked lead screws: seen from the front, a bed is carried on nuts on two upright lead screws, each with the same toothed pulley at its foot, and one motor under the base drives a closed toothed belt that runs round both pulleys; seen from above, the belt loops round the two screw pulleys and the motor pulley, kept tight by a spring idler. Animated: the motor turns, the belt carries both screws round together, and the bed rises level, pauses, then comes back down.

g.text: One motor, one closed toothed belt: it can't slip, so both screws turn exactly the same amount
